title: Why Plastic Keeps Showing Up Inside Your Organs
hook: Doctors are now finding plastic inside organs that should never see it.
closing: Plastic you can't see is inside us now, and it may be hurting our hearts.
question: Does this freak you out too?

segments.say: Plastic in human brain tissue jumped by about half in eight years. Whatever we're breathing and eating, it's getting in, and fast.
Plastic showed up in every placenta tested, and in most donors' blood. It isn't staying outside us.
Plastic in artery plaque went with over four times the risk of heart attack, stroke or death. A link, not proven cause.
